Class ShipInitializationState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.ShipInitializationState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateInterface
public non-sealed class ShipInitializationState extends GameState implements GameStateInterface
Represents the state of the game where players initialize their ship cabins.

    • initializeCabin

      public void initializeCabin(ShipBoard shipBoard, Point point, CrewType crewType)
      Initializes a cabin on the ship board with the specified crew type. Calls ShipBoard.initializeCabin(Point, CrewType). Changes state to DrawCardState if all ship boards have no more cabins to initialize
      Overrides:
      initializeCabin in class GameState
      Parameters:
      shipBoard - the ship board initializing the cabin
      point - the position of the cabin
      crewType - the type of crew to assign to the cabin
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the specified cabin does not need to be initialized

    • goNext

      public void goNext(ShipBoard shipBoard)
      Initializes all empty cabins on the ship board with humans. Calls ShipBoard.initializeCabin(Point, CrewType). Changes state to DrawCardState if all ship boards have no more cabins to initialize
      Overrides:
      goNext in class GameState
      Parameters:
